limits: Technical score only; all visual90 points unscored. All24 camera pixels inspected for evidence validity, not graded as art.
Native cold-open/objective probes executed, with no source saves. No rebuild, render, runtime/Unity, collision/navmesh, FPS, measured engine draw-call or export test performed by this critic.
The author repair native present at report time has not been scored. This report applies only to frozen4da and completed cycle13.

The root verifier terminates assembly paths at inherited object names. Its130 declared small-part passes and102 object passes do not prove attachment of every component or architecture-rooted support.

Whole-room geometric graph finds possible contact using sampled vertices, edge midpoints, face centres and edge intersections; a negative sampled result alone is not a defect. Only the six inherited families with exhaustive separating AABB lower bounds plus actual intended-support rays are elevated to critical findings.

The other unrooted graph clusters remain unresolved diagnostic candidates and are not counted as critical findings. Fully enclosed parts, bevel cavities and intended moving mechanisms need individual interpretation.

2668 nearly zero-area evaluated triangles were counted across8 objects (mostly subdivided bench and impact lining); this is technical cleanup debt, not an outward-winding failure or a newly confirmed visual blocker. No exhaustive duplicate-triangle/self-intersection/manifold certification is claimed.

Named physical UVs are object-local dominant-face planar projections scaled by object scale. Tiled overlaps and coordinates outside0–1 are intentional; they are not a unique atlas or lightmap. Retained Generated/Object/Geometry graph inputs have their own coordinate semantics.
